_meta.source: Shogun Showdown wiki, Regions and Bamboo Grove pages (shogunshowdown.wiki.gg), fetched 2026-10-28, CC BY-SA 4.0; spawn details from the Stage 1 domain model.
_meta.visitors: A region's 'visitors': standard enemies of another region seen in its waves although the route did not pass their home region. The wiki's spawn pool lets the Yumi Sniper appear after the player has met it in its home region; your save met it in recording 2 (Hibiku Wastelands, collect/20261029-160032), and it came to Moonlit Port in that recording (f0512-f0518, f0583-f0597) and in run 20261030-115221, whose route went through Whispering Caves (Moonlit Port I waves 3 and 5, II wave 3, III wave 2). Named only by the tile in their bubble, never by HP pips alone.
_meta.observed_day1: Regions played in the full-game recording (collect/20261028-190026, Day 1, won): each wave level's width from the board reader and its wave count from the HUD counter, in play order, and the boss arena's width; null where the board could not be read. Moonlit Port's widths come from the dark-board reader of 0.30 and were the same in the second recording (collect/20261029-160032, f0462-f0778). Hideyoshi's Keep had one wave level, not the three the wiki's level count implies [rec: progress track at f1383].

rules.cells: Each level is 5, 7 or 9 cells wide [wiki].
rules.boss_levels: Boss levels have no waves; killing the boss ends the level even with summons alive [wiki] [web].
rules.rewards: Between levels: a tile choice (one of two, or skip) or a tile upgrade; options can be rerolled for coins [wiki].

spawn_patterns.normal: next wave when only 1-2 enemies remain [web]; Bamboo Grove spawns while 1 is alive, at once when 0 [obs]
spawn_patterns.quick: spawns on a turn interval until the cap or the pool is reached [web]

rules.spawn_pool: Enemies from earlier regions can appear later; Yumi Sniper, Warden, Strider and Kabukai only after meeting them in their home region [wiki].
